blind.description: A stylized fantasy wooden chest propped open and filled with various curiosities and antiquities. The chest is crafted from warm wood planks reinforced with dark iron edge-straps and gold rivets. Inside, resting on a deep purple/maroon velvet lining, is a curated collection of oddities: a horned animal skull, a carved wooden mask with gold inlays, two red and gold scroll cases, clusters of sharp green crystals, and clusters of purple amethyst crystals. Surfaces are clean, continuous, and stylized hand-painted game art with no floating or broken geometry.
blind.from_above: A top-down rectangular view showing the open chest interior packed with objects: two red-and-gold scroll canisters in the upper left, a carved wooden tribal mask in the upper right, a horned skull across the center, with sparkling purple crystals on the left and green crystals on the bottom edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2 ft tall to the top of the open lid) and about 2 ft wide.
